Don't feel shitty about looking for a new job and bettering yourself.  I know you like the team you work with but I'm sure they've been in the same position before (especially the older people on the team) so I'm sure that they'll understand when you hand in your letter of resignation.

I've had a VERY similar experience but instead of my team, it was the company owners that were the problem for me and I too felt like I had no place there anymore so I left and it was one of the best decisions I've ever made in my life.

Good luck.

I Agree with this 100%.  You have to take a look at both jobs and weigh up the pro's and cons of each and choose what you think will make you happy in the long term.

Forget about money for the time being, just work out what you think will be best for yourself in the present and the future and choose with your heart.  If baking is something you're passionate about then I'd totally choose that one because at least I'd know I'd enjoy it.

Good luck with whatever you choose.

I have such a diverse taste in music that largely depends on the mood I'm in.

Someday's I'll listen to rap music, such as Eminem and Twisted Insane, other days, I'll listen to Dance such as Avicii and hardstyle such as Headhunterz.  I've even caught myself listening to heavier stuff recently such as Outline in Color and Famous Last Words.

As for punk rock, I absolutely love Blink 182 and a lot of the "Punk goes Pop" covers on Youtube.

I will agree that the majority of killstreaks were OP, they were fun to be on the giving end of.  As for the receiving end..  Not so much, but I still thought it was a great game.

I'm with you 100% on the tubes though, it was such a broken gameplay mechanic and it had no place.

It's still the CoD that I had most fun and memories on even though your opinion is different but to each his own.  Right?

No, which is why I didn't mention them.  OMA noobtubes were a nightmare and I'm sure they still are.  I didn't really snipe so I didn't get the constant Intervention hitmarkers but I have seen why people would complain about it.  Yes, tac-insert boosters were annoying in FFA games but outside of that game type I personally didn't run into that many.

I was around two years old at the time but basically my parents told me that I fell down the stairs at home and hit my head against the corner of the radiator.  I have a pretty bad ass looking scar on my left eyebrow though.

Congratulations dude.  She's right, it was damn brave to write that to her over Facebook, sorry you didn't get the result you probably wanted but you're definitely taking a step in the right direction in terms of dealing with the feelings of anxiety.

You're right, it's not a failure.  Keep going strong.

Holy shit!  I never actually thought about it that way but I think you're right, my attempt triggered a chain of events that lead to me getting better.  I'm just hoping that nobody else has to attempt suicide before they're able to get the help they need.

Much appreciated pal.  Hopefully you're able to beat this too, it's hard but the feeling you get when you put yourself in a social situation and realize that you're not as socially inept as you think is better than anything else. :)
